irreducibility.statement: the region chain is irreducible: every region is reachable from every other and none is absorbing, so the compression trigger recurs indefinitely - the anticipated event is actuarially inevitable across the cycle, and no event is dated

trigger_recurrence.statement: the compression cross fires at this rate per market per year: the entry condition is not a rare event but a recurring feature of the cycle, and the forward log accumulates at this actuarial rate
